title: Add presubmit prober and minimal dependency curator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a lightweight presubmit prober for fast sanity checks and a minimal dependency curator to mark low-risk bumps eligible for fastpath CI. No runtime API changes.
description: Summary: Adds a compact presubmit prober workflow plus a lightweight dependency-curation action that labels low-risk dependency bumps for the fastpath CI lane. Motivation: full CI runs are expensive and slow feedback on busy weekdays increases engineering cycle time. The presubmit prober provides a <30s healthcheck early in the pipeline; the dep-curator reduces noise by auto-classifying routine dependency bumps and allowing them to take a trimmed CI path. This PR implements the mechanism and the operational controls (opt-in label, denylist, and safety gate). --- Changes and intent: 1) .github/workflows/presubmit-prober.yml - new workflow that runs on PRs and executes a minimal matrix of fast health checks (lint-lite, small unit smoke, config-validator). It runs within seconds by using cached tool images and a dedicated fast runner. 2) .github/actions/dep-curator/action.yml - repository action that inspects dependency-related PRs (renovate/depbot) and applies the "ci/fastpath-eligible" label when bump passes heuristics (patch/minor semver, no native code/binary deps, test-only transitive changes). 3) scripts/prober/health_check.py - prober script that exercises crucial startup paths: model routing schema validation, minimal API contract smoke against mocked runtime, and config validator. 4) ci/fastpath-evaluator.py - small evaluator used by the curator to double-check changed files & run quick offline heuristics. 5) docs/ci/fastpath.md - operational guide describing how to opt-in/out, denylist edits, and how to troubleshoot prober failures. 6) .github/workflows/integration.yml - small refactor to add a gate that skips heavy integration shards when "ci/fastpath-eligible" label is present. --- Commits: - c1a2f6d: add presubmit prober workflow and prober script - e3b9a12: add dependency curator action and evaluator - f5d8b44: docs and CI gate wiring; comments and tests for edge cases --- Files changed (high level): - .github/workflows/presubmit-prober.yml (new) - .github/actions/dep-curator/action.yml (new) - scripts/prober/health_check.py (new, +120 lines) - ci/fastpath-evaluator.py (new, +80 lines) - docs/ci/fastpath.md (new) - .github/workflows/integration.yml (modified, ~30-line tweak) - .github/labels/ci.yml (updated denylist) --- Test matrix and CI: First run showed a lint error in health_check.py (flake8 E302) which was fixed in c1a2f6d::fix-lint. Unit smoke tests and a fast integration shard were added to the prober matrix. Final CI status: all checks passed (lint, unit-fast, prober-smoke, e2e-lite). The heavy integration shards are gated and did not run for the dep-curator candidate PRs once the fastpath label was applied. --- Review thread (high level): - Arjun Patel (review): "Nice idea. Please add metrics for prober false positives/negatives and a TTL for fastpath labels so we don't accidentally allow stale labels." - Maya Chen (author): "Added metrics.emit('ci.prober.result', ...) in c1a2f6d and added 7-day TTL enforcement in ci/fastpath-evaluator.py; updated docs." - Elena Alvarez (review): "Safety concern: what about deps that touch native bindings? Please add a denylist and explicit override for that class." - Maya Chen: "Added denylist and explicit override requiring manual review for files matching /native/ or glibc-binding patterns; documented it in docs/ci/fastpath.md." - Samir Gupta (approval): "Verified local runs of prober and curator; okay to squash-merge after fixing the small lint issues." --- Operational notes and rollout plan: - Feature flags: presubmit-prober is enabled by default for all PRs but the curator only labels PRs originating from renovate/depbot or with a title matching dependency bump heuristics. - Opt-out: maintainers can set label ci/fastpath-exempt to force full CI. - Monitoring: added CI metrics (ci.prober.latency, ci.prober.pass_rate, ci.fastpath.label_count) to the console dashboard; alert if prober pass_rate drops below 98% for a 1-hour window. - Safety: the curator rejects any PR touching files in the denylist (infra/native-build, third_party/binaries) and will not label those PRs. A manual review is required. - Rollout: rolled to canary org members for 24hrs, then rolled to all repos on the org-wide workflow runner. --- Rationale vs alternatives considered: - Could have used a heavier classifier or ML model for dep risk scoring; rejected due to operational complexity and inversion of the fast feedback loop. - Could have broadened the prober to run a subset of integration tests, but that increased runtime; we prioritized sub-30s execution. --- Merge and post-merge work: - Merge method: squash and merge. - Post-merge: monitoring dashboard tile added; follow-up tasks created ENG-2189 to expand denylist and ENG-2190 to add historical metrics backfill. --- Impact and risk assessment: - Expected: 25-40% reduction in full CI runs for dependency-only PRs, median PR feedback time down from ~12m to ~90s for fastpath-eligible cases. - Risk: misclassification of risky dependency bumps. Mitigation: conservative heuristics, denylist, TTL on labels, and dashboards/alerts. --- Manual steps performed during merge: - Verified canary runner logs, validated that curator did not label a known native-binding bump in canary. - Notified SRE and platform channels. --- Notes for maintainers: - To adjust sensitivity thresholds edit ci/fastpath-evaluator.py constant RISK_SCORE_CUTOFF. - If a repository prefers to disable the curator, remove the .github/actions/dep-curator binding in that repo's workflow. --- Related: ENG-2145 (fastpath design), ENG-2201 (CI cost reduction OKR), SUP-3421 (customer incident that motivated faster feedback). --- This PR is intentionally lightweight in code and conservative in policy; follow-ups will expand the heuristics and add an optional ML-based scorer behind a feature flag.
